name: NeuroScale Notification Agent
description: Low-code notification agent built in UiPath Agent Builder. Receives incident data from Maestro Case, sends Slack alerts, emails on-call engineers, and creates Jira tickets for critical incidents.

template.text:
{{ severity_emoji }} *NeuroScale Ops — Incident Detected*

*Alert ID:* `{{ alert_id }}`
*Root Cause:* `{{ root_cause_type }}`
*Severity:* `{{ severity }}`
*Confidence:* `{{ confidence }}`
*Namespace:* `{{ namespace }}`
*Action:* `{{ recommended_action }}`

> {{ description }}

*AI Reasoning:* {{ ai_reasoning }}

👉 <{{ maestro_case_url }}|View in Maestro Case>

template.subject: [{{ severity.upper() }}] K8s Incident: {{ root_cause_type }} — {{ alert_id }}
